name: TestVanDammeAnim + BroBase base states
source: Decompiled Broforce game source: TestVanDammeAnim, BroBase
note: Every entry names the fields that steer TestVanDammeAnim.ChangeFrame to one Animate* method, the field the frames are stepped with, and the cells the base sprite sheet holds for it. Unqualified member names are TestVanDammeAnim's; BroBase's are qualified. Expected cells were cross-checked against the sprite validator's base range table. The harness re-applies setup before every step, so animations that clear their own flag mid-sequence still run to the end of their column span. An entry with knownMismatch addresses fewer cells than its expect says for a reason the source explains, and the driver reports it separately from a real mismatch. An entry marked lethal pins the bro dead (actionState Dead, health 0), which a BroMaker hero takes for its death and runs its own OnDeath for, though the game itself takes no life and respawns nothing; the driver leaves it out unless includeLethal is set. Unless allowSideEffects, the harness skips the swept bro's UseSpecial, UsePockettedSpecial, BroBase.PerformKnifeMeleeAttack, BroBase.PerformPunchAttack, Land, TriggerFlexEvent, FireWeapon and ReleaseHeldObject, and the Map and MapController damage methods game-wide, for the duration of a sweep, so the states that walk those frames fire nothing at the level. A step's call list runs right after ChangeFrame, the way the game's Update runs RunGun after it; provide gives a state the ZipLine or ladder collider it needs.

states.name: idle
states.note: ChangeFrame's Idle arm -> AnimateIdle; the !ducking arm falls through to AnimateActualIdleFrames (frame % 1 is always 0). BroBase.AnimateActualIdleFrames forwards to the base method only while BroBase.gettingUpFromElbowSlam and BroBase.isAirFlexing are false. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: idle_firing
states.note: The idle body of idle (AnimateActualIdleFrames) with the recoil walk on the gun, row 1 columns 3 to 0. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: idle_ducking
states.note: AnimateIdle takes the ducking arm when ducking && useDuckingFrames, then that arm's final else -> AnimateActualIdleDuckingFrames (6 + frame % 1). The BroBase.AnimateActualIdleDuckingFrames override forwards while BroBase.gettingUpFromElbowSlam is false. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: idle_ducking_firing
states.note: The ducking body of idle_ducking (AnimateActualIdleDuckingFrames) with the recoil walk on the gun, row 1 columns 3 to 0. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: running
states.note: ChangeFrame's Running arm -> AnimateRunning; its last arm, past every Animate* and rolling case, needs !throwingHeldObject, !doingMelee, !releasingHighFive, no usingSpecial*, pushingTime <= 0, rollingTime <= 0 and rollingFrames <= 0. useNewFrames then routes to AnimateActualNewRunningFrames (frame % 8, row 2 while !dashing). Footstep sound and poof effect fire at frame % 4 == 0. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: running_firing
states.note: running's body held at frame 0 (AnimateActualNewRunningFrames) with the recoil walk on the gun, row 1 columns 3 to 0. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: running_dashing
states.note: Same path as running; AnimateActualNewRunningFrames' SpriteSM.SetLowerLeftPixel selects spritePixelHeight * 4 instead of * 2 when dashing && useDashFrames. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: running_legacy
states.note: AnimateRunning, the !useNewFrames arm: frame % 4 on row 1.

states.name: running_ducking
states.note: AnimateRunning takes the ducking arm when ducking && useDuckingFrames -> AnimateActualDuckingRunning; the useNewDuckingFrames arm is 8 + frame % 8 on row 2. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: running_ducking_legacy
states.note: AnimateActualDuckingRunning, the !useNewDuckingFrames arm: 6 + frame % 4 on row 1. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: pushing
states.note: AnimateRunning needs pushingTime > 0 && useNewPushingFrames && !fire -> AnimatePushing (frame % 8 on row 5). The gun overlay is mirrored by AnimatePushing's last statement. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: panicking
states.note: ChangeFrame's Panicking arm sets the cell inline: 15 + frame % 4 at y = spritePixelHeight. No Animate* method and no layout flag is involved.

states.name: jumping_rising_momentum
states.note: ChangeFrame's final Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping -> AnimateActualJumpingFrames. Its yI > 20 arm with useNewFrames needs |xI| > 50 -> frame % 3 on row 3. Reaching that final arm needs every earlier Jumping arm of ChangeFrame false: throwingHeldObject, usingSpecial*, ledgeGrapple, chimneyFlip, wallClimbing, WallDrag, isInQuicksand, the wall-anticipation arm (blocked by left/right false), rollingTime and airdashTime. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_rising_slow
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingFrames: yI > 20 and |xI| <= 50 -> 6 + frame % 3 on row 3. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_firing
states.note: jumping_rising_slow's body held at frame 0 (AnimateActualJumpingFrames) with the recoil walk on the gun, row 1 columns 3 to 0. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: jumping_falling_momentum
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingFrames: yI < -55 and |xI| > 50 -> 3 + frame % 3 on row 3. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_falling_slow
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingFrames: yI < -55 and |xI| <= 50 -> 9 + frame % 3 on row 3. The middle arm (-55 <= yI <= 20) addresses the same two column groups. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_legacy_rising
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingFrames, the !useNewFrames arm of the yI > 20 branch: fixed column 1 on row 1. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_legacy_falling
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingFrames, the !useNewFrames arm of the yI < -55 branch: fixed column 2 on row 1. gunFrame is pinned at 0, since the gun cell is written only while gunFrame <= 0.

states.name: jumping_ducking_rising
states.note: AnimateJumping takes the ducking arm when ducking && useDuckingFrames -> AnimateActualJumpingDuckingFrames; its first arm is the yI > 20 case, fixed column 8 on row 1.

states.name: jumping_ducking_falling
states.note: AnimateActualJumpingDuckingFrames: both the yI < -10 arm and the else arm use column 9 on row 1.

states.name: front_somersault
states.note: AnimateJumping -> BroBase.AnimateActualJumpingFrames, its BroBase.frontSomersaulting arm: needs BroBase.frontSomersaulting && BroBase.hasNewAirFlexFrames and both WallClimbing and WallDrag false, else it clears the flag and re-enters ChangeFrame. 10 + frame % 12 on row 11.

states.name: elbow_slam
states.note: BroBase.AnimateActualJumpingFrames, its BroBase.isElbowSlamming arm: BroBase.isElbowSlamming && BroBase.hasNewAirFlexFrames. 18 + BroBase.flexSpecialFrame on row 14, clamped to 3 in that arm. yI must be <= 50 or the arm's BroBase.flexSpecialFrame == 1 && yI > 50 check resets BroBase.flexSpecialFrame to 0 before the cell is written.

states.name: air_flex
states.note: AnimateIdle -> BroBase.AnimateActualIdleFrames -> BroBase.AnimateAirFlexing (BroBase.isAirFlexing && BroBase.hasNewAirFlexFrames, and BroBase.gettingUpFromElbowSlam false so the elbow-slam arm ahead of it does not win). 18 + BroBase.flexSpecialFrame on row 13. Side effects: BroBase.AnimateAirFlexing calls BroBase.AirFlexJump at frame 3, which adds jump force, and clears BroBase.isAirFlexing and sets BroBase.frontSomersaulting at frame 4; yI and BroBase.frontSomersaulting are pinned, so each step starts from them.

states.name: getting_up_from_elbow_slam
states.note: AnimateIdle -> BroBase.AnimateActualIdleFrames, its BroBase.gettingUpFromElbowSlam arm -> BroBase.AnimateGettingUpFromElbowSlam. 18 + BroBase.flexSpecialFrame on row 15; BroBase.flexSpecialFrame >= 4 exits the state instead of drawing.

states.name: airdash_side
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping airdash arm needs canAirdash && airdashTime > 0 -> AnimateAirdash; the Left/Right case with airDashDelay <= 0 is frame % 3 on row 8.

states.name: airdash_side_delayed
states.note: AnimateAirdash, the Left/Right case while airDashDelay > 0: 13 + frame % 3 on row 8.

states.name: airdash_up
states.note: AnimateAirdash, the Up case: 10 + frame % 3 on row 8. The gun is deactivated in that case.

states.name: airdash_down
states.note: AnimateAirdash's Down case -> AnimateAirdashDown, which needs yI <= -50 or it falls through to AnimateJumping. 3 + frame % 3 on row 8.

states.name: chimney_flip
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping && chimneyFlip arm -> AnimateChimneyFlip, which addresses 22 - chimneyFlipFrames on row 7. ChangeFrame decrements chimneyFlipFrames before dispatch, so the stepped values run 12..1 to address columns 11..22. The last step also clears chimneyFlip in AnimateChimneyFlip.

states.name: rolling
states.note: AnimateIdle's rollingFrames > 0 arm -> AnimateRolling, which addresses 19 + (13 - rollingFrames) on row 2. ChangeFrame decrements rollingFrames before dispatch, so the stepped values run 13..2 to address columns 20..31. AnimateRunning's rollingFrames > 0 arm reaches the same method from actionState Running. The animation is only authored for bros that roll on landing, hence the requires; the dispatch itself does not read doRollOnLand.

states.name: insemination
states.lethalReason: reached through AnimateDeath, so it pins actionState Dead and health 0 the way death_grounded does
states.note: ChangeFrame's Dead arm -> AnimateDeath; its first arm needs IsInseminated() (inseminatedCounter > 0) and CalculateInseminationFrame() >= 0 (Mathf.Clamp((int)((0.45 - inseminatedCounter) * 22.222223), -1, 7)) -> AnimateInseminationFrames, 11 + that frame on row 8. The stepped counter values land mid-bucket for frames 0..7. No inseminatorUnit reference is needed: ChangeFrame only touches it when it is non-null.

states.name: ladder_transition_out
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm (with throwingHeldObject/doingMelee/usingSpecial* false) -> AnimateClimbingLadder. Both the no-ladder arm and the no-input arm reach AnimateClimbingLadderTransition(false) when useLadderClimbingTransition && ladderClimbingTransitionFrames > 0, so it is the one ladder cell group reachable away from a ladder. Mathf.Clamp(ladderClimbingTransitionFrames, 0, 5) on row 7; column 0 is unreachable because the gate is > 0.

states.name: hanging_moving
states.note: ChangeFrame's Hanging arm -> AnimateHanging; the left/right arm is 11 + frame % 12 on row 4. The gun is deactivated in that arm and the sprite offset is (0, -2) from the SetSpriteOffset ahead of it.

states.name: hanging_one_armed
states.note: AnimateHanging, the no-input arm: 23 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 5) on row 4, hangingOneArmed set there (ChangeFrame clears it before dispatch). wasHangingMoving must be false or the arm zeroes frame after the harness has set it. The arm draws no gun cell, so each step calls StartHanging after ChangeFrame, as the game does on grabbing the ceiling: with ducking false and gunFrame 0 it sets Hanging and SetGunSprite(0, 1), the hanging column gunSpriteHangingFrame (6) on row 2.

states.name: hanging_firing
states.note: hanging_one_armed's body held at frame 0 (AnimateHanging) with the recoil walk on the gun: SetGunSprite's Hanging branch adds gunSpriteHangingFrame (6), so row 1 columns 9 to 6. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: highfive_hold
states.note: AnimateIdle's holdingHighFive arm -> AnimateHighFiveHold: 16 + 1 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 2) on row 1. highfiveHoldTime is pinned far negative so its highfiveHoldTime > 0.5 check cannot call high5Bubble.RestartBubble, and highFiveNoBoost suppresses its CheckHighFive.

states.name: highfive_hold_legacy
states.note: AnimateHighFiveHold, the !useNewHighFivingFrames arm of its cell expression: 16 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 2) on row 1.

states.name: highfive_release
states.note: AnimateIdle's releasingHighFive arm -> AnimateHighFiveRelease: 16 + 1 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 2, 5) on row 1. successfulHighFive false keeps it from spawning effects and highFiveNoBoost blocks its CheckHighFive. The terminating branch is frame >= 6 here, so no step self-cancels.

states.name: highfive_release_legacy
states.knownMismatch: frame 4 writes column 20 and then clears releasingHighFive and re-enters ChangeFrame (AnimateHighFiveRelease's terminating branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel idle pose rather than column 20
states.note: AnimateHighFiveRelease, the legacy arm: 16 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 2, 4) on row 1. Known limitation: the terminating branch is frame >= 4 for legacy, so the last step writes column 20 and then clears releasingHighFive and re-enters ChangeFrame, which overwrites the sprite with the idle pose before the harness reads it.

states.name: throwing_new
states.knownMismatch: frame 7 writes column 24 and then clears throwingHeldObject and re-enters ChangeFrame (AnimateThrowingHeldObject's case 7), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 24
states.note: AnimateIdle's throwingHeldObject arm -> AnimateThrowingHeldObject; the useNewThrowingFrames arm is 17 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 7) at y = spritePixelHeight * 5. SetHeldObjectPos and ReleaseHeldObject are null-safe. Known limitation: frame 7 clears throwingHeldObject and re-enters ChangeFrame in that arm's case 7, so that step's captured cell is the post-cancel pose.

states.name: throwing_legacy
states.note: AnimateThrowingHeldObject, the legacy arm: 17 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 5) on row 1. Frame 3 clears throwingHeldObject in that arm's case 3; the harness re-applies the setup before every step, so frames 4 and 5 still dispatch. No recursive ChangeFrame here, so every column is captured.

states.name: special_new
states.knownMismatch: frame 7 writes column 24 and then clears usingSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame (AnimateSpecial's frame >= 7 branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 24
states.note: AnimateIdle's usingSpecial arm -> AnimateSpecial; the useNewThrowingFrames arm is 17 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 7) at y = spritePixelHeight * 5. Frame 4 would fire the bro's real special via UseSpecial; the harness patches UseSpecial out for the sweep. Known limitation: frame 7 clears usingSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame in that arm, so that step's captured cell is the post-cancel pose.

states.name: special_legacy
states.note: AnimateSpecial, the legacy arm: 16 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 4) on row 1. Frame 2 would fire UseSpecial; the harness patches it out for the sweep. Frame 4 clears usingSpecial in that arm but does not re-enter ChangeFrame, so every column is captured.

states.name: pocketed_special
states.knownMismatch: frame 10 writes column 26 and then clears usingPockettedSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame (TestVanDammeAnim.AnimatePockettedSpecial's frame >= 10 branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 26
states.note: AnimateIdle's usingPockettedSpecial arm -> BroBase.AnimatePockettedSpecial, which forwards to TestVanDammeAnim.AnimatePockettedSpecial for every type except Airstrike/MechDrop/AlienPheromones: 16 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 10) at y = spritePixelHeight * 12. Frame 4 would fire UsePockettedSpecial, which the harness patches out for the sweep. Known limitation: frame 10 clears the flag and re-enters ChangeFrame in its frame >= 10 branch, so that step's captured cell is the post-cancel pose.

states.name: pocketed_special_airstrike
states.knownMismatch: frame 7 writes column 24 and then clears usingPockettedSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame (BroBase.AnimatePockettedSpecial's frame >= 7 branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 24
states.note: BroBase.AnimatePockettedSpecial handles Airstrike/MechDrop/AlienPheromones itself: 17 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 7) at y = spritePixelHeight * 5. Frame 4 would fire BroBase.UsePockettedSpecial, which the harness patches out for the sweep. Known limitation: frame 7 clears the flag and re-enters ChangeFrame in its frame >= 7 branch.

states.name: melee_knife_standing
states.knownMismatch: frame 6 writes column 31 and then CancelMelee clears doingMelee and re-enters ChangeFrame (TestVanDammeAnim.CancelMelee, from BroBase.AnimateKnifeMelee's frame >= 6 branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 31
states.note: AnimateIdle's melee arm (doingMelee && !canDoIndependentMeleeAnimation) -> BroBase.AnimateMelee -> BroBase.AnimateKnifeMelee: 25 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 6) on row 1 while standingMelee. meleeFollowUp false keeps BroBase.AnimateMeleeCommon from rewinding frame, and highFive false blocks its mook-throw. Frame 3 calls BroBase.PerformKnifeMeleeAttack unconditionally (BroBase.AnimateKnifeMelee's frame == 3 branch); the harness patches it out for the sweep, so the frames still walk but nothing is hit.

states.name: melee_knife_jumping
states.knownMismatch: frame 6 writes column 23 and then CancelMelee clears doingMelee and re-enters ChangeFrame (TestVanDammeAnim.CancelMelee, from BroBase.AnimateKnifeMelee's frame >= 6 branch), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 23
states.note: ChangeFrame takes the melee arm before the Jumping arm -> BroBase.AnimateMelee -> BroBase.AnimateKnifeMelee, its !standingMelee && jumpingMelee arm: 17 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 6) on row 6. SetMeleeType forces standingMelee for bros without useNewKnifingFrames, which is why these cells are only authored for bros that set the flag. BroBase.StartKnifeMelee hides the gun and ChangeFrame's !doingMelee guard on ActivateGun keeps it hidden; the jumping melee arm never touches it, so step.call runs DeactivateGun. On frame 6 the game's CancelMelee re-enters ChangeFrame and re-activates the gun there, so the call also hides a gun the game shows on that last step, whose body cell is already the known post-cancel mismatch.

states.name: melee_punch
states.note: BroBase.AnimateMelee routes Punch and JetpackPunch to BroBase.AnimatePunch: 25 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 8) on row 9, of which the sheet holds 25-31. Its frame == 3 BroBase.PerformPunchAttack is gated on !meleeHasHit, which the setup pins true, so no punch lands even before the harness's suppression patch. Frame 7 would clear the melee in its frame >= 7 branch, which is why the steps stop at 6.

states.name: gesture_flex
states.note: AnimateIdle's currentGesture != None arm -> AnimateGesture, overridden by BroBase.AnimateGesture which calls the base first. The cell is Mathf.Min(frame, span - 1) * 32 at (9 + gestureIndex) * 32 (AnimateGesture's last statement), giving row 12 for Flex. blockMovementForGesture true keeps Update's gesture clear from clearing the gesture whenever actionState is not Idle or fire or special is set, and AnimateGesture's own end-of-span clear from firing. Side effects at frames 8 and 18: PlayFlexSound, TriggerFlexEvent and DisConnectFaceHugger (AnimateGesture's Flex case), plus BroBase.AnimateGesture's flex-power effects.

states.name: death_grounded
states.lethalReason: pins actionState Dead with health 0, which a BroMaker hero reads as its death and runs its own OnDeath for; the game itself calls neither Death nor ReduceLives and the respawn countdown runs on the frozen clock, so no life is lost and nothing respawns during the sweep
states.note: ChangeFrame's Dead arm -> AnimateDeath; with inseminatedCounter 0 and Y <= groundHeight + 0.2 it takes its else arm -> AnimateActualDeath, fixed column 5 on row 1. groundHeight is pinned above any world position so the grounded arm is chosen regardless of where the bro stands.

states.name: death_falling
states.lethalReason: pins actionState Dead with health 0, which a BroMaker hero reads as its death and runs its own OnDeath for; the game itself calls neither Death nor ReduceLives and the respawn countdown runs on the frozen clock, so no life is lost and nothing respawns during the sweep
states.note: AnimateDeath's second arm needs Y > groundHeight + 0.2 and impaledByTransform null -> AnimateFallingDeath, fixed column 4 on row 1. groundHeight is pinned below any world position to force this arm.

states.name: wall_drag_hand_a
states.note: ChangeFrame's WallDrag arm (WallDrag, the property over the wallDrag field) -> AnimateWallDrag; the useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with yI <= 100 and knifeHand even is 12 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 4) on row 3. ConstrainToWalls hides the gun on this path (in each of its four wall branches) and AnimateWallDrag does not, so step.call runs DeactivateGun after ChangeFrame.

states.name: wall_drag_hand_b
states.note: AnimateWallDrag, the odd-knifeHand mirror: 22 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 4) on row 3. ConstrainToWalls hides the gun on this path (in each of its four wall branches) and AnimateWallDrag does not, so step.call runs DeactivateGun after ChangeFrame.

states.name: wall_drag_rising_hand_a
states.note: AnimateWallDrag, the yI > 100 arm with knifeHand even: 12 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 1) on row 3. The wall branch that hides the gun needs yI <= maxWallClimbYI (100) or wallClimbing (its condition in ConstrainToWalls), which these pins do not satisfy, so the gun is left as ChangeFrame's ActivateGun call sets it.

states.name: wall_drag_rising_hand_b
states.note: AnimateWallDrag, the yI > 100 arm with knifeHand odd: 22 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 1) on row 3. The wall branch that hides the gun needs yI <= maxWallClimbYI (100) or wallClimbing (its condition in ConstrainToWalls), which these pins do not satisfy, so the gun is left as ChangeFrame's ActivateGun call sets it.

states.name: wall_drag_legacy_hand_a
states.note: AnimateWallDrag, the !useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with knifeHand even: 11 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 2) on row 1. ConstrainToWalls hides the gun on this path (in each of its four wall branches) and AnimateWallDrag does not, so step.call runs DeactivateGun after ChangeFrame.

states.name: wall_drag_legacy_hand_b
states.note: AnimateWallDrag, the !useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with knifeHand odd: 14 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 2) on row 1. ConstrainToWalls hides the gun on this path (in each of its four wall branches) and AnimateWallDrag does not, so step.call runs DeactivateGun after ChangeFrame.

states.name: wall_climb_hand_a
states.note: ChangeFrame's wallClimbing && !fire arm -> AnimateWallClimb; the useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with frame < 8 and knifeHand even is 12 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 4) on row 3. yI must be <= 16 or its frame == 1 branch decrements frame at step 1.

states.name: wall_climb_hand_b
states.note: AnimateWallClimb, the odd-knifeHand mirror: 22 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 4) on row 3.

states.name: wall_climb_legacy_hand_a
states.note: AnimateWallClimb, the !useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with knifeHand even: 10 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 3) on row 1. Frame 1 sets yI to 190 in that arm; the harness re-applies the setup before every step so the pinned yI is restored. AnimateWallClimb's legacy arm does not hide the gun (only the new-frames arm does, as its first statement) but ConstrainToWalls does (in each of its four wall branches), so step.call runs DeactivateGun.

states.name: wall_climb_legacy_hand_b
states.note: AnimateWallClimb, the !useNewKnifeClimbingFrames arm with knifeHand odd: 13 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 3) on row 1. AnimateWallClimb's legacy arm does not hide the gun (only the new-frames arm does, as its first statement) but ConstrainToWalls does (in each of its four wall branches), so step.call runs DeactivateGun.

states.name: ledge_grapple
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm tests ledgeGrapple and routes it to AnimateRunning, which is before the only two call sites of AnimateJumping (ChangeFrame's final Jumping arm and AnimateAirdashDown). AnimateJumping's own ledge-grapple arm and AnimateLedgeGrapple (row 3, columns 12-25, driven by ledgeOffsetY) therefore cannot be reached by pinning fields and calling ChangeFrame.

states.name: ladder_climb_up
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm -> AnimateClimbingLadder, which needs IsNearbyLadder, a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + Transform.localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. Holding up, the last arm draws frame % 8 on row 6 with the gun deactivated. ladderClimbingTransitionFrames is pinned at 5 so AnimateClimbingLadderTransition(true), which bumps it and zeroes frame, is not taken.

states.name: ladder_climb_down
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm -> AnimateClimbingLadder, which needs IsNearbyLadder, a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + Transform.localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. Holding down, the down arm draws 8 + frame % 3 on row 6 with the gun deactivated; yI is pinned at 0 so the fast-slide foot poofs are not spawned. ladderClimbingTransitionFrames is pinned at 5, as for ladder_climb_up.

states.name: ladder_one_armed_hang
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm -> AnimateClimbingLadder, which needs IsNearbyLadder, a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + Transform.localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. With no input the one-armed arm sets hangingOneArmed and draws 11 + frame % 3 on row 6, and the gun through SetGunSprite(0, 0), whose ClimbingLadder && hangingOneArmed branch adds gunSpriteHangingFrame (6): row 1 column 6. ladderClimbingTransitionFrames is pinned at 0 so the transition arm does not take the frame.

states.name: ladder_climb_legacy
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm -> AnimateClimbingLadder, which needs IsNearbyLadder, a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + Transform.localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. Without useNewLadderClimbingFrames the moving arm draws frame % 4 on row 1 and the gun through SetGunSprite(0, 0): hangingOneArmed is false, so row 1 column 0.

states.name: zipline_moving
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null to AnimateZipline. provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs ZipLine.Start or ZipLine.Update. Holding right on a horizontal line, the moving arm draws 11 + frame % 12 on row 4 with the gun deactivated.

states.name: zipline_hanging
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null to AnimateZipline. provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs ZipLine.Start or ZipLine.Update. With no input the hanging arm draws 23 + Mathf.Clamp(frame, 0, 5) on row 4 and writes no gun cell, so each step calls AttachToZipline with the provided line, as the game does on grabbing one: SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0) with Jumping and a zipline adds gunSpriteHangingFrame (6), row 1 column 6. It also zeroes frame after the cell is drawn, which the next step's pin undoes.

states.name: zipline_firing
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null to AnimateZipline. provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs ZipLine.Start or ZipLine.Update. Firing takes the hanging arm (!fire fails the moving test), 23 on row 4 at frame 0; ZipLine.isGuts is false and slidingOnZipline is pinned false, so no particles are spawned. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon is suppressed unless allowSideEffects. SetGunSprite's zipline branch adds 6: row 1 columns 9 to 6.

states.name: impaled
states.note: ChangeFrame requires impaledByTransform != null && useImpaledFrames before AnimateImpaled (row 2 columns 10-12) can run.

states.name: impaled_dead
states.note: AnimateImpaled (row 2 columns 8-9) is the actionState Dead arm of the same method, behind the same impaledByTransform gate in ChangeFrame.

states.name: on_back_of
states.note: ChangeFrame dispatches to AnimateOnBackOffUnit (row 2 column 12) only while onBackOf != null.

states.name: strung_up
states.note: ChangeFrame dispatches to AnimateStrungUpFrames (row 1 column 15) only while strungUpBy != null; AnimateJumping has the same gate.

states.name: wall_anticipation_stab
states.unsupported: keyed to a live world position
states.note: AnimateWallAnticipation (row 3 columns 16-21 and 26-31) picks its column from Y + knifeClimbStabHeight - lastKnifeClimbStabY, a delta against the position where the knife was last planted. A static field value cannot express it, and the dispatch in ChangeFrame's wall-anticipation arm also needs left/right plus canTouchLeftWalls/canTouchRightWalls, which are set by wall contact.

states.name: wall_climb_stab
states.unsupported: keyed to a live world position
states.note: AnimateWallClimb (row 3 columns 16-21 and 26-31) is the frame >= 8 arm and picks its column from Y + knifeClimbStabHeight - lastKnifeClimbStabY, the same live delta.

states.name: frozen
states.unsupported: no cells on the bro sheet
states.note: ChangeFrame dispatches to AnimateFrozen while frozenTime > 0, but BroBase overrides it with an empty body (BroBase.AnimateFrozen), so a bro never addresses the TestVanDammeAnim frozen cells.
